phase1_gate.proceed_basis: Aggregate mAP50 gate was NOT met, but the project explicitly proceeds on PPE-present capability (n:0.811, s:0.833 AP50, both above the 0.70 gate) plus the Phase 6 spatial compliance engine. Phase 3 has been executed under this basis; the aggregate metric is expected to rise with Phase 4 site-specific fine-tuning.
phase1_gate.recommendation: Phase gate NOT met by aggregate mAP50. However, PPE-present classes already exceed gate (n:0.811, s:0.833). Proceed to Phase 3 with YOLOv8s best.pt + spatial compliance engine. Aggregate mAP50 will improve with Phase 4 site-specific fine-tuning.
phase1_gate.edge_model: YOLOv8n (98.6 FPS on T4, Hailo-8L NPU ready)

root_cause_of_gate_failure.summary: Violation classes (no_X) are severely underrepresented in dataset
root_cause_of_gate_failure.fix: Use spatial association compliance engine (Phase 6) instead of no_X classification
